title: The Crooked Oath
author: Jude Zhou
blurb: Yara Blackwood, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
